dash.title: Dashboard
dash.text: A summary of what needs the team's attention today.
dash.sourcesNote: Based on what applicants answer in "How did you hear about us?".

students.title: Students
students.emptyText: Change the filters or clear the search.

detail.notFoundText: The record may have been removed or the demo data was reset.
detail.blocked: The stage cannot be completed before all required documents are verified.
detail.blockedUni: Pick at least one university for this student before moving on.
detail.unisText: Chosen by the team. The student sees these in their account.
detail.capWarn: CSC allows at most {{n}} applications a year per applicant. Adding more may not be accepted.
detail.needOffer: Mark one university as admitted before moving on.
detail.needAccept: The student must confirm one offer before arrival planning.
detail.closedNote: Closed because another offer was accepted

pipeline.title: Application pipeline
pipeline.text: Drag a student card to the next stage or use the arrows.

docs.title: Document review
docs.text: Review uploaded documents, then verify them or return them to the student with a clear reason.
docs.emptyText: You cleared everything in this list.

arrivals.title: Arrival manifest
arrivals.text: The daily list for the reception teams in Shanghai and Beijing.
arrivals.emptyText: Student details appear here once they enter their flights.

form.errPaid: Paid amount must be between 0 and the total

delete.title: Delete student?
delete.text: You are about to delete {{name}} and their application.
delete.warning: This also removes their documents and messages. This cannot be undone.

staff.title: Staff
staff.text: Manage advisors, ground team and managers.
staff.deleteText: You are about to remove {{name}} from the team.
staff.deleteBlocked: This person still has students or arrivals assigned. Reassign them first.

unis.title: Universities
unis.text: The partner universities you work with, and everything the team needs to know about each one.
unis.emptyText: Add a partner university or change the filters.
unis.statusHint: Paused universities are hidden from the public site and from the student picker.
unis.zhHint: Short form shown on the card, e.g. 复旦
unis.programsHint: Separate with commas, e.g. Business, Medicine
unis.errWebsite: Enter a full link starting with https://
unis.errTuition: Enter a valid minimum and maximum
unis.deleteText: {{name}} will be removed from your partner list and from the public site.
unis.deleteBlocked: {{n}} students currently have this university in their applications. Remove it from their accounts first, or pause the partnership instead.
